thread:
Alex (AE): FYI incoming from Acme Health — they want a 90d on-prem POC and asked if we can waive platform fees + provide Gold support at no charge during the POC.
Nina (SE): POC size? infra footprint?
Alex (AE): request is small: 2 x A100 equivalent nodes, primarily inference & embeddings. They said potential enterprise deal afterwards but declined to give commit numbers.
Nina (SE): technically doable. platform fee normally covers private control plane + packaging. waiving is a big lift operationally.
Carlos (DealDesk): what are the list prices we should reference?
Alex (AE): standard onprem platform fee = $18k/mo. Gold support = $5k/mo.
Carlos (DealDesk): baseline $23k/mo. Waiving for 3 months would be ~ $54k net. We have a discount cap of 35% for onprem without CRO signoff. Full waive would need CRO ok.
Mei (CISO): security note: they asked for HSM-backed key storage and on-site audit access for encrypted logs. we can't grant on-site audits, but we can provide redacted audit artifacts and a DPA. HSM in Private requires additional infra — lead time ~ 6 weeks.
Ravi (Legal): also they want a clause limiting liability to $0 during POC — not acceptable. we can do a reduced liability cap for POC but must maintain baseline indemnities.
Alex (AE): customer pushing hard because of healthcare regs. any creative commercial constructs we can offer?
Nina (SE): option 1: 40% off platform fee for 90d + onboarding credit $12k. keep Gold support billed. option 2: full waive of platform fee if they sign a 12-mo minimum commit (post-POC) at standard rates + MSA amendment. option 3: time-limited 'trial license' where platform fee billed but refunded pro-rata upon conversion.
Carlos (DealDesk): prefer Option 1 (faster approval). Option 2 requires CRO approval and Legal to lock the post-POC commit language. Option 3 OK but we need cashflow alignment.
Mei (CISO): for POC we can accept customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-kms) and provide SOC2 summary + signed DPA. add checklist item: keys never stored in our control plane.
Ravi (Legal): if we go Option 2, we need an explicit acceptance checklist, conversion notification window (30 days), and clear termination/rollback responsibilities. I'll draft a POC addendum template.
Alex (AE): customer asked also if support can cover Monday-Friday 9-5 SLAs for the POC. do we have a reduced support SKU?
Nina (SE): we can offer Standard support (Mon-Fri 9-5) during POC at no extra cost but bill Gold on conversion. state it clearly in amendment.
Carlos (DealDesk): I'll log the exception: ticket #DD-2031. proposing Option 1: 40% platform discount for 90 days + $12k onboarding credit, Standard support included for POC. Need: (1) SE checklist, (2) Legal POC addendum, (3) CISO signoff on temporary BYOK approach.
revenue-bot: Exception request DD-2031 submitted to revenue-ops. Approval ETA 48h.
Mei (CISO): I'll prepare the SOC2 summary + BYOK doc and a short HSM roadmap note.
Ravi (Legal): Alex — please send me the customer's security questionnaire PDF and any special DPA asks. I'll work up the addendum.
Nina (SE): I'll upload the POC acceptance checklist: `acme_poc_checklist_v1.md` (link) — includes perf targets: 95th < 400ms, p99 < 800ms, data purge steps, and encryption verification steps.
Alex (AE): i'll share the questionnaire now in the deal CR and loop the customer.
ops-bot: Artifact created: `acme_poc_checklist_v1.md` attached to CR-1189.
Carlos (DealDesk): routing Option 1 for approval now. if revenue-ops pushes back, escalate to CRO. keep this thread updated.
Alex (AE): thanks team. I'll update Acme: propose Option 1 and make clear conversion terms. will post customer reply here. :pray:
